question: g3_checkout_request
answer:
Created [checkoutRequest.mjs](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/source/work/g3_checkout_request/source/codex/5/src/util/checkoutRequest.mjs) — that's the only file changed. It maps the inputs onto the backend's request-class field names, which differ from what the storefront currently sends:

| param | backend field | defined in |
|---|---|---|
| `shippingOptionId` | `quoteId` | `PersistableOrder` |
| `currency` | `currency` | `Order` (v1) |
| `agreedToTerms` | `termsAccepted` | `Order` (v1) |
| `comments` | `orderNote` | `Order` (v1) |
| — | `payment.paymentType` = `"CREDITCARD"`, `payment.transactionType` = `"CAPTURE"` | `PersistablePayment` (enums `PaymentType`/`TransactionType`) |
| `paymentModule` | `payment.processor` | `PaymentEntity` |
| `paymentToken` | `payment.cardToken` | `PersistablePayment` |
| `amount` | `payment.amount` | `PaymentEntity` |

Files consulted: [Checkout.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/source/work/g3_checkout_request/source/codex/5/src/pages/other/Checkout.js) (how the storefront builds the call) plus `constant.js`/`webService.js` for the `cart/<code>/checkout` path, and in the backend repo the endpoint in `OrderApi.java` (`/cart/{code}/checkout` → `PersistableAnonymousOrder`) and the model classes `PersistableAnonymousOrder`, `PersistableOrder`, `Order`, `PersistablePayment`, `PaymentEntity` (under `sm-shop-model`/`sm-core-model`), plus the `PaymentType`/`TransactionType` enums to confirm `CREDITCARD`/`CAPTURE`.
